links.outcome: Diagnostic sensitivity and specificity of AI versus explicit diagnostic criteria for TIA, against neurologist reference standard
links.effect: AI sensitivity 98.5%, specificity 11.7%; EDCT v1-3 sensitivities 95.5%, 91.0%, 91.0% with specificities 23.3%, 43.3%, 46.7%. AI labelled 119/127 patients as TIA.
links.quote: Structured clinical criteria (EDCT) outperformed an advanced AI model in distinguishing TIA from mimics in an emergency setting.

unlisted_practices: Steering (prompt adjustment) of an LLM to improve diagnostic specificity, which raised specificity only slightly (18.3%) and reduced sensitivity
Using structured explicit diagnostic criteria as a benchmark for validating AI diagnostic tools

screen.reason: Empirical study testing OpenAI O3-mini-high on real-world clinical cohort data for TIA diagnosis versus explicit clinical criteria, including evaluation of steering prompts to adjust AI specificity/sensitivity.
